import { test, describe, it, beforeEach } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
let booted = false;
test('probe', () => { booted = existsSync('/run/systemd/system') && !!process.env.NEVER; });
test('acceptance: the engine units', async (t) => {
  const up = existsSync('/run/systemd/system') && !!process.env.NEVER;
  await t.test('the unit file parses', () => {});
  if (up) await t.test('the unit starts', () => {});
});
